learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize students with the basics and the structure of the artificial intelligence scientific discipline.
Provide knowledge in problem solving, games theory, planning, fuzzy logic and expert systems.
Basic orientation in artificial intelligence problems.
Ability to use optimization methods, problem solving techniques, fuzzy systems building and orientation in expert system problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction (Introduction to AI, basic terms, AI segmentation)
Transition system, problem formulation, uninformed state-space search (depth first search, breadth first Search)
Uninformed state-space search (limited depth first search, iterative depth first search, lowest cost first Search)
Games theory, minimax algorithms, minimax algorithm with alfa-beta prunning, heuristic minimax
Fuzzy relations and operations with fuzzy relations, fuzzy numbers
assessment_rules: The course requires solving a final complex project comprising different tasks from individual parts of the subject. Assessment includes an oral examination and evaluation of home assignments. The form of course completion is an examination.
